title: Free-seeder-flora foundational growth architecture
scope: Foundational strategy of the K3 free-seeder kingdom at qualitative grain. Species, vault anatomy, dormancy limits, cues, bank densities, dispersal, crop candidates, human uses, Mana patterns, and local presence remain open.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C strategy cards were presented with A recommended, the Author selected 'A — Vault-seed' on 2026-08-17.
question: What foundational strategy should define the K3 free-seeder kingdom?
selection: Vault-seed flora: individual, short-lived, fast-growing opening specialists whose signature is the seed vault, a durable dormant capsule waiting in soil for years or decades until disturbance cues wake it. The population's persistent form is the buried vault bank; disturbed ground erupts primarily from banks already present, and old worked land carries buried seed legacies. Dispersal is secondary and remains open.
alternatives: K3-ARCH-B: far-travelling wanderer seeds chasing disturbance; not selected (loses buried-legacy texture).
K3-ARCH-C: extreme multi-generation seasonal tempo; not selected (echoes the declined boom-and-bust direction).
rationale: Dormant vault banks are the strongest fit for a world where seventy years of suppressed land is waking, give farming and disturbance scenes a concrete mechanism, and complete a distinct non-overlapping persistence strategy for every producer kingdom: K1 living networks, K2 standing structure, K4 anchors, K3 dormant vaults.
consequences: K3 members are individual short-lived opening specialists persisting as buried dormant vault banks.
Disturbance history becomes a living archive: old clearances and worked land carry buried seed legacies.
Fields and disturbed ground gain grounded flush-and-weed pressure from their own banks.
Each producer kingdom persists by a distinct strategy, keeping kingdom identities crisp.
Later weed, pioneer, and crop-ancestor development must build on this strategy.
No germination guarantee, crop, human practice, guaranteed harvest, or System mechanic is created.
residual_unknowns: Species, forms, sizes, chemistry, energy capture, and growth habits remain open.
Vault anatomy, dormancy limits, cue specifics, viability decay, and bank densities remain open.
Dispersal mechanisms, ranges, and animal interactions remain open.
Crop-ancestor candidates and any human use remain open.
Mana patterns, pests, diseases, and symbioses remain open.
reopening_conditions: The vault-bank strategy cannot support required opening ecology or agricultural texture.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
